info.name: TheTaxi Driver Mobile API
info.description: Complete API collection for TheTaxi Driver Mobile Application. Includes authentication, status, location tracking, sessions, device management, booking assignments, hires, earnings, and trip lifecycle endpoints (with assignment-scoped canonical lifecycle endpoints).

item.name: Authentication

request.description:
Authenticate a driver and receive access and refresh tokens.

Response now includes `current_assignment` (active DriverAssignment with booking/booking_item details, or null) and `trip_phase` (current trip lifecycle phase: accepted, pickup_arrived, in_progress, or null).

response.name: Login Success (With Active Assignment)

request.description: Retrieve the authenticated driver's profile. Response now includes `assignment_statistics` with total_assignments, active_assignments, and completed_assignments counts.
Refresh the access token using the refresh token.
Logout the authenticated driver by revoking their current token.

item.description: Driver authentication endpoints including login, logout, profile, and token refresh.

item.name: Status Management

request.description:
Set the driver's status to online and start a new session.

Response now includes `pending_assignments` â€” an array of DriverAssignments in active/pending_approval status with booking and booking_item details.

Set the driver's status to offline and close the active session.

If a trip tracking session is active, the trip remains active and the response includes a `trip_warning` message and `active_trip` details.

response.name: Go Offline With Active Trip Warning

request.description: Retrieve the driver's current online/offline status and active session information.

item.description: Endpoints for managing driver online/offline status and sessions.

item.name: Heartbeat

request.description:
Send a heartbeat signal to indicate the driver is still active. Should be sent every 60 seconds while online.

When a trip tracking session is active, the response includes `trip_phase` and `assignment_id`.

item.description: Heartbeat endpoint to maintain driver's active status.

item.name: Location Tracking

request.description: Send the driver's current GPS location. Creates a route point for the active session. During an active trip, the route point is also linked to the assignment_id. Should be sent every 10 seconds while moving.

Upload location points buffered on the device during temporary network issues. Duplicate points are skipped when `recorded_at`, `latitude`, and `longitude` match an already stored point for the active session or another point in the same payload.

query.description: Optional. Fetch trip-specific route points for a given assignment.
Optional. Fetch route points for a specific driver session.
Optional ISO datetime lower bound for recorded_at (e.g. 2026-04-04T00:00:00Z).
Optional ISO datetime upper bound for recorded_at.
Optional max points to return (1-10000, default 5000).

request.description:
Retrieve driver location history using the same endpoint for both live and replay use cases.

Default behavior:
- Returns active session route points.
- If no active session exists, returns the latest session route points.

Optional filters:
- assignment_id: get trip-specific route points (works after trip end)
- session_id: get route points for a specific session
- from/to: recorded_at time window
- limit: max points (1-10000)

Each route point includes assignment_id so maps can distinguish trip-linked vs general movement.

item.description: Endpoints for tracking and retrieving driver location data.

item.name: Trip Tracking

request.description: Canonical endpoint: get trip status for a specific assignment. Response includes all generated route stops in `stops`, the next actionable stop in `current_stop`, and assignment-level `allowed_actions`.

request.description: Multi-stop endpoint. Marks the current route stop as arrived. Previous stops must already be completed or skipped.
Multi-stop endpoint. Completes an arrived pickup stop as picked_up. Use only when `current_stop.type` is `pickup` and `current_stop.status` is `arrived`.
Multi-stop endpoint. Completes an arrived dropoff stop as dropped_off. Use only when `current_stop.type` is `dropoff` and `current_stop.status` is `arrived`.
Multi-stop endpoint. Skips the current pickup/dropoff stop. Skipped stops are terminal and allow the driver to move to the next stop.
Canonical endpoint: complete trip for a specific assignment.

item.description: Trip lifecycle tracking endpoints. Manage the full trip flow: check status, confirm pickup arrival, start trip, route stop progress for multi-stop hires, and end trip with summary. Waiting time is automatically detected during in_progress phase. Multi-stop hires return all stops in status responses and must complete or skip every stop before ending the hire.
